text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to pray at a shrine with Dream 
Journey, who had been stuck in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Are you finished making your wish? Good 
work.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You were praying quite earnestly for a 
very long time, weren't you?
choice_data_list:
I was hoping it would help you feel even a 
little better...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us begin formulating a 
concrete plan—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That bargeboard ornament is gorgeous, 
isn't it? Is that an inome gegyo design?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The fin carvings feel so powerful. They 
strike an exquisite balance with the 
graceful metal fittings...
choice_data_list: You know a lot about this, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My father is a goldsmith, you see. 
Because of that, I have been drawn to such 
ornamentation ever since I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Gazing upon beautiful things is wonderful. 
...It brings such peace of mind.
choice_data_list:
Then how about we take a stroll around the 
shrine grounds?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There might be other things she finds 
beautiful. If seeing them helps refresh 
her mood—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Once in a while might be nice. Shall 
we go?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The main shrine looks quite impressive 
from here as well... There really is a 
certain beauty you can only appreciate 
from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The contrast between ancient beauty and 
lush nature. A work of art beyond all 
calculation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Dream Journey let out a breath, her 
profile seemed just a little more relaxed 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was thanks to the shrine visit 
or just a refreshing change of pace, Dream 
Journey managed to regain her form.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a message from one of my 
committee members. Please excuse me for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Is something the matter? If so, I can 
make new arrangements—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...That requires urgent attention. I 
shall visit in person. See you shortly."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but trouble arose with the 
Overseas Expedition Support Committee. I 
must head over immediately to handle it in 
person.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am so very sorry. It is a shame that I 
could not take a walk through the shrine 
grounds with you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey walked away with a 
disappointed look. Her condition hadn't 
improved...
